name: OKC_BUS_VARIABLES_B
description: This table stores all the business variables that can be used in clauses. This table contains variables of all type - System-defined, User-defined, Table and Deliverable.

columns.name: VARIABLE_CODE
columns.description: This is the primary key. It will be sequence based system generated in the case of user defined variables and a code in the case of seeded variables i.e. system, table or deliverable variables. These seeded variables are prefixed as OKC$S and OKC$B where B and S indicate Buy and Sell respectively.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VARIABLE_TYPE
columns.description: This defines the type of the variable. The valid values are S=System, U=User Defined, T=Table, D=Deliverable.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_YN
columns.description: Yes/No flag to indicate whether this variable can be updated by external users or not e.g. supplier. Currently applicable only to Procurement Contracts.

columns.name: VARIABLE_INTENT
columns.description: This defines the  Intent of the variable i.e. Buy or Sell. Foreign Key to FND_LOOKUPS of lookup_type OKC_ARTICLE_INTENT.

columns.name: CONTRACT_EXPERT_YN
columns.description: Yes/No flag to indicate whether this variable is being used in Contract Expert or not.

columns.name: DISABLED_YN
columns.description: Yes/No flag to indicate whether this variable can no longer be used.

columns.name: VARIABLE_DATATYPE
columns.description: This is the datatype of the variable as defined in the value set corresponding to it (D= Date, N=Number, V=Varchar2).

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: This column references the owning application in the case of system variables.  This is a foreign Key to FND_APPLICATION.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: VALUE_SET_ID
columns.description: This defines the source of the user-defined variable value. This is mandatory for user-defined variables. Foreign Key to FND FLEX Value Sets.

columns.name: VARIABLE_DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.description: For future use.  This column stores the  default value for user-defined variables.

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the variable is a seeded one. Used to flag the PRM seeded variables

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: XPRT_VALUE_SET_NAME
columns.description: Primary source for the contract expert enabled system variable values

columns.name: LINE_LEVEL_FLAG
columns.description: Identify if the system variable is a line level variable. For all other variable types this would always be 'N'

columns.name: DATE_PUBLISHED
columns.description: Date the variable was published , specifically used for XML based Clause Import.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_CODE
columns.description: This is used to preserve source of code for variables to be imported from external system. User FYI only.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: This is used to preserve source of identifier1 for variables to be imported from external system. User FYI only.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID2
columns.description: This is used to preserve source of identifier2 for variables to be imported from external system. User FYI only.

columns.name: METHOD_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the CLASS.METHODNAME to source user defined variables. This is not applicable / not used in base R12 and prior releases.

columns.name: VARIABLE_SOURCE
columns.description: Indicator to identify user defined varaible source. Possible values are M (Manual) and J (Java class and method)

columns.name: METHOD_TYPE
columns.description: Method type

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
